Stekler (born January 3, 1953) is a political documentary filmmaker, a professor, and former head of the production program in the Department of Radio-Television-Film at the University of Texas at Austin College of Communication. He is most famous for the series of four Inspector Palmu movies, based on the character created by Mika Waltari.  During his long career, he has won seven Jussi Awards, including a concrete Jussi for lifetime achievement, and received numerous other commendations.  His 1959 film "Punainen viiva" was entered into the 1st Moscow International Film Festival.
